name: TMS Protocol Parameters 8
definition: Configuration parameters of the TMS protocol between a POI and a terminal manager.

ActionType.name: Action Type
ActionType.definition: Type of action for the configuration parameters.

TerminalManagerIdentification.name: Terminal Manager Identification
TerminalManagerIdentification.definition: Identification of the master terminal manager or the terminal manager.

ProtocolVersion.name: Protocol Version
ProtocolVersion.definition: Uniquely identifies the protocol name and version to use when using these parameters.

MaintenanceService.name: Maintenance Service
MaintenanceService.definition: Maintenance services provided by the terminal manager.

Version.name: Version
Version.definition: Version of the TMS protocol parameters.

ApplicationIdentification.name: Application Identification
ApplicationIdentification.definition: Identification of applications which may be managed by the TM, partially or globally.

HostIdentification.name: Host Identification
HostIdentification.definition: Identification of the terminal manager host.

POIIdentification.name: POI Identification
POIIdentification.definition: New identification of the POI for the terminal manager.

InitiatingPartyIdentification.name: Initiating Party Identification
InitiatingPartyIdentification.definition: New identification of the initiating party to set in TMS messages with this terminal manager.

RecipientPartyIdentification.name: Recipient Party Identification
RecipientPartyIdentification.definition: New identification of the recipient party to set in TMS messages with this terminal manager.

FileTransfer.name: File Transfer
FileTransfer.definition: Configuration parameters are exchanged per file transfer protocol rather than per message.

ExternallyTypeSupported.name: Externally Type Supported
ExternallyTypeSupported.definition: List of types that the receiver supports and that the sender could use as type of an ExternallyDefinedData message component.
